title: Patchwork
description: Five scraps settle into a collage and are stitched together.
alt: Peach, striped blue, dotted rose, checked linen and yellow scraps of cloth drift together, overlap, and a dark line of running stitches is sewn across them.
note: Flat shapes read as cloth once each has a small repeating pattern and they blend where they overlap. The stitch was first the same linen colour as the cloth and vanished. Review then caught pattern grounds in colours outside the palette; building them from palette colours at low opacity also made the collage lighter.
author: Maria Roszyk
